lines.text: Asked him, not asked to him!
Many learners say: I asked to him the way.
Better: I asked him the way.
The second! I asked him the way.

data.wrong: I asked to him the way.

native.tip: Türkçede “ona sordum” (“-e”) deriz; İngilizcede “ask” fiilinden sonra “to” gelmez.
native.caption: “I asked to him the way” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “ask” fiilinden sonra “to” kullanılmaz. Doğrusu “I asked him the way.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “him”. “Ask” sonrası “to” gelmez. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Do not put “to” after “ask”: “I asked him the way.”
en.caption: Do you say “I asked to him the way”? 😅 In English there is no “to” after “ask” before the person. The right sentence is “I asked him the way.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
